title: Programa settings.json
description: User-level Programa settings. Programa accepts JSON with comments (JSONC) and trailing commas, but the underlying data model matches this schema.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL for editor completion and validation.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for forward-compatible migrations. Newer versions are parsed on a best-effort basis.

app.title: app
app.description: General app preferences from Settings > App.

light.description: Ghostty theme used with Programa's light appearance.

dark.description: Ghostty theme used with Programa's dark appearance.

terminalTheme.description: Terminal themes from Settings > Appearance. Use null, or null for both variants, to remove Programa's managed theme override and inherit Ghostty configuration.

terminalOpacity.description: Terminal background opacity from Settings > Appearance. Use null to remove Programa's managed override and inherit Ghostty configuration.

terminalBlur.description: Terminal background blur from Settings > Appearance. Use null to remove Programa's managed override and inherit Ghostty configuration.

terminalFont.description: Terminal font from Settings > Appearance. Use null to remove Programa's managed override and inherit Ghostty configuration.

newWorkspacePlacement.description: Where new workspaces are inserted in the sidebar.

minimalMode.description: Hide the workspace title bar and move controls into the sidebar.

preferredEditor.description: Custom editor command used by Programa where applicable. Leave empty to use the default.

reorderOnNotification.description: Move workspaces with new notifications toward the top.

warnBeforeQuit.description: Show a confirmation before quitting Programa.

commandPaletteSearchesAllSurfaces.description: Search every surface in the command palette switcher instead of only the active workspace.

command.description: Optional shell command to run alongside notification delivery.

longCommandThresholdSeconds.description: Minimum duration, in seconds, a command must run before a finish notification is posted for a pane the user isn't looking at. 0 disables this notification entirely.

workspaceColors.title: workspaceColors
workspaceColors.description: Workspace tab and badge colors from Settings > Workspace Colors.

indicatorStyle.description: Active workspace indicator style. Legacy aliases are accepted and normalized.

selectionColor.description: Override the selected workspace background color.

notificationBadgeColor.description: Override the unread notification badge color.

colors.description: Full named workspace color palette. Include built-in entries you want to keep, remove keys to remove colors, and add more named entries to extend the picker.

sidebarAppearance.title: sidebarAppearance
sidebarAppearance.description: Sidebar tint settings from Settings > Sidebar Appearance.

matchTerminalBackground.description: Use the terminal background instead of the sidebar tint.

tintColor.description: Base sidebar tint color used when light/dark overrides are not set.

lightModeTintColor.description: Sidebar tint override for light appearance.

darkModeTintColor.description: Sidebar tint override for dark appearance.

showClaudeQuota.description: Show Claude Code rate-limit headroom (5h/7d windows) in the sidebar footer, read from ~/.claude/tmp/rate-limits.json when present.

automation.title: automation
automation.description: Socket control and automation settings from Settings > Automation.

socketControlMode.description: Socket control mode. Legacy aliases are accepted and normalized.

socketPassword.description: Password for password-mode socket access. Use null or an empty string to clear it.

claudeCodeIntegration.description: Enable Programa integration hooks for Claude Code.

openBrowserWithAgentSplits.description: Open a browser split beside the terminal when a new agent workspace is created.

claudeBinaryPath.description: Custom path to the claude binary.

portBase.description: Starting value for workspace PROGRAMA_PORT assignments. The complete range must fit within 1-65535.

portRange.description: Number of ports reserved per workspace. The complete range must fit within 1-65535.

customCommands.title: customCommands
customCommands.description: Custom command trust settings from Settings > Custom Commands.

trustedDirectories.description: Directories whose programa.json (or legacy cmux.json) commands can run without confirmation.

browser.title: browser
browser.description: Embedded browser settings from Settings > Browser.

defaultSearchEngine.description: Default search engine for non-URL queries.

openTerminalLinksInProgramaBrowser.description: Open clicked terminal links in the embedded browser.

interceptTerminalOpenCommandInProgramaBr.description: Intercept terminal open http(s) commands and route them through the embedded browser.

hostsToOpenInEmbeddedBrowser.description: Allowlist of hosts that should stay inside the embedded browser.

urlsToAlwaysOpenExternally.description: Rules that always open matching URLs in the system browser.

externalBrowser.description: Bundle identifier of the browser used for http(s) links that open outside Programa, for example com.apple.Safari. Empty uses the macOS default browser.

externalAppOpenAllowlist.description: Bundle identifiers of apps for which you chose Always allow in the external app open prompt. Links that open these apps skip the prompt.

insecureHttpHostsAllowedInEmbeddedBrowse.description: HTTP hosts allowed in the embedded browser without a warning prompt.

proxy.description: Route the embedded browser through a proxy. Requires host and port; type defaults to socks5.

host.description: Proxy host name or IP address.

type.description: Proxy protocol type. "socks5" uses SOCKSv5; "httpConnect" uses HTTP CONNECT tunneling. Defaults to "socks5".

directory.description: Base directory for new git worktrees created via 'programa worktree create' (or the 'worktree.create' socket method) when no explicit --path is given. Worktrees are created under <directory>/<repo-name>/<branch-slug>.

shortcuts.title: shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Keyboard shortcut settings from Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts.

showModifierHoldHints.description: Show shortcut hint pills while holding Cmd or Ctrl.

bindings.description: Shortcut overrides keyed by Programa action id. Use a string for a single shortcut or an array for a chord.

windows.title: windows
windows.description: Settings read by the Windows frontend only. The macOS app ignores this section.

shortcuts.title: shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Windows keyboard bindings keyed by action. A binding is modifiers and one key joined by hyphens, for example ctrl-shift-t. Modifiers are ctrl, alt and shift; the key is one letter or digit, comma or insert. ctrl-c, ctrl-d and ctrl-w are reserved for the terminal, and no two actions can share a binding.
